001: Hi, Ana! Everything's great, and you?
That's good! Are you heading to class now?
Me too. Want to go together?
002: Good morning, Mrs. Marta! How are you doing?
Good morning, dear! I'm doing very well, thank you.
That's great! Do you need anything?
No, sweetie, I just came out for a little walk.
Then I have to go, see you later!
See you later, dear. Come back anytime!
003: Hi, Gabriel! Long time no see!
Hi, Fernanda! I know, it's been a while since we've seen each other.
You disappeared! Where have you been?
That's cool! We need to get together and catch up.
For sure! Let's set up a coffee.
004: Good afternoon! Are you the new neighbor?
Good afternoon! Yes, I just moved in.
Welcome to the building! My name is Beatriz.
Nice to meet you, Beatriz. I'm Rafael.
Nice to meet you, Rafael. If you need anything, just knock on my door.
Thank you so much! That's very kind.
005: Hey, Camila! All good, and you?
That's good! Have you had lunch yet?
Then let's go to that new restaurant?
006: Hello, how are you? Are you Ana's sister?
Hello! Yes, that's me. And you must be Lucas.
That's right! Nice to meet you.
The pleasure is mine. Ana talks about you a lot.
007: Good evening, dear! How was your day?
Have a seat, rest for a bit.
Thanks. That smells delicious! What did you make?
I made that dinner you like.
008: Hi, how are you? You're Pedro, right?
Hi! No, I'm his cousin, Gabriel.
Oh, sorry! It's just that you two look a lot alike.
No problem, that happens a lot.
Nice to meet you, I'm Mariana.
Nice to meet you, Mariana! Pedro will be here soon.
009: Hi, everyone! Good to see you here.
Hi, Ana! We were waiting for you.
I was late because the traffic was terrible.
Don't worry about it, we understand. You just got here, right?
010: Hi, Grandma! How are you doing?
Hi, my dear grandson! I'm doing well, thank God.
That's good! Did you sleep well?
That's great! I came to visit you today.
What a joy! Come in, I'll make you a cake.
